**Coaching Note:**

When the king runs to an exposed square, look for a queen check that controls the escape squares. Here, Qg7+ forces the king to h5, where Qxh7 is mate. Black's king had already cut off by moving to h6—that was the mistake. Spot when your opponent's king wanders into danger and deliver the knockout blow immediately.
